message.content:
This document is the README for **Project Maya**, a local LLM inference stack. Key technical points:

**Purpose & Features**
- Anthropic-compatible API with tool calls, aimed at coding agents.
- Handles up to 8 concurrent requests using GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, and MiniMax-M3.1-Flash.
- Includes browser chat + live monitor, image support on all models, thinking levels, a Models page (download/load/delete), a Turbo button, and one-command setup.
